'''Mario Boley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2001 Bochum tournament]] in November 2001 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC]], according to Bastian Winkelhaus's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3114">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-the-circle-is-now-completed3114/ the-circle-is-now-complete], DeckTech (Bastian "Death Star" Winkelhaus, 23 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-the-circle-is-now-completed3114/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
